content.text:
No. `src/services/user-service.js` still calls `query` and `update` from `../db.js` directly, using callbacks. It never imports `UserRepository`, and the comment on line 3 says it hasn't been migrated yet ("Chapter 5 migrates this to UserRepository").

`src/repositories/user-repository.js` already has the promise-based methods that would replace each function:

| `user-service.js` (callback) | `UserRepository` (promise) |
|---|---|
| `listActiveUsers(callback)` | `findActive()` |
| `findUser(id, callback)` | `findById(id)` |
| `softDeleteUser(id, when, callback)` | `softDelete(id, when)` |

The project has a `migrate-module` skill that does exactly this for one service file and then runs its tests. Moving to promises would change the service's exported signatures, so whatever calls these functions would need updating too. I can run the migration if you want.
